_doc: Applied after group_*.json. 'drop': employer regexes removed from a company. 'window': an employer regex only counts for a company between from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), e.g. before an acquisition closed or after a spin-off.

drop.why: MHWirth merged into HMH, a 50% joint venture Akastor does not consolidate

window.why: HENT moved to Sentia, listed 13 Jun 2025; Ratos now a minority holder
Matas took over KICKS in Oct 2024
Schouw consolidates BioMar (majority owner); also counted under BioMar Group, listed Jun 2026
